'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Nelson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck name '''SoCal Watch Your Step (V)'''. Username sheet '''Antog2003'''; dest [[Aaron Nelson]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Antog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
